From #dspace:

pbecker: Until I haven’t finish DS-2081 I won’t have time to review. Sorry.
[11:49pm] pbecker: Hope to get it done till friday evening (european evening ).
[11:49pm] hpottinger: is 2081 a bugfix?
[11:50pm] pbecker: you can disucss if it is a bufix or an improvement. But you gave me an extension till friday.
[11:50pm] hpottinger: it's marked as an improvement in JIRA... but... looks like a bug fix
[11:50pm] pbecker: See DSPR#672
[11:51pm] kompewter: [ https://github.com/DSpace/DSpace/pull/672 ] - DS-2081: Delete EPersons even if submitted Items or are refrenced elsewhere in DSpace by pnbecker
[11:51pm] pbecker: I was suggesting to change the type to bugfix. And if you’re okay, I would still do.
[11:51pm] hpottinger: extension til Friday sounds fine
[11:51pm] hpottinger: tdonohue: has a good feel for what to call issues
[11:51pm] tdonohue: 2081 could be considered a bugfix in my opinion. It results in a nasty / annoying error...so fixing that would be nice
[11:51pm] hpottinger: I defer to him
[11:52pm] pbecker: okay, I change it and copy this chat in a comment.
[11:52pm] tdonohue: Though 2081 is a lot of code changes...so it would need more thorough testing or corresponding Unit Tests
